root_cause: The Portal V2 candidate diverged from current main while Netlify production/build contracts had advanced. The stale candidate preview failed its build and Required test also lacked same-lineage closure artifacts.
prevention_rule: Before a material Portal V2 promotion, synchronize the single candidate head with current main, bind PR metadata to the authoritative base, require exact-head Netlify preview evidence, and carry Brain learning, development ledger, and human change documentation in the same lineage.
regression_contract: Portal V2 Tests plus exact-head Netlify Deploy Preview and Required test must pass before protected merge; parent navigation and expanded navigation derive from the same canonical taxonomy.

evidence.outcome: Netlify deploy preview recovered, PR #3530 merged, and production deploy 6abe4c249f07cb0008e14578 published exact main SHA 4a4f1f3d8deb9aed23b0a168dd0140b04dce803d. Follow-up readback fixes align tests with the canonical sidebar and harden immutable navigation.
